an11.12:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
an11.12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena mahānāmo sakko gilānā vuṭṭhito hoti aciravuṭṭhito gelaññā.
an11.12:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.12:2.2: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.12:2.4: athakho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an11.12:2.6: sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti
an11.12:2.8: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kena vihārena vihātabbanti.
an11.12:3.2: etaṃ kho mahānāma tumhākaṃ paṭirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ yaṃ tumhe tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā puccheyyātha
an11.12:3.3: tesaṃ no bhante nānāvihārehi viharataṃ kena vihārena vihātabbanti
an11.12:3.4: saddho kho mahānāma ārādhako hoti no asaddho
an11.12:3.9: imesu kho tvaṃ mahānāma pañcasu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya cha dhamme uttariṃ bhāveyyāsi
an11.12:4.2: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an11.12:4.3: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.12:4.4: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha
an11.12:4.5: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.12:4.6: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an11.12:4.7: imaṃ kho tvaṃ mahānāma buddhānussatiṃ gacchantopi bhāveyyāsi ṭhitopi bhāveyyāsi nisinnopi bhāveyyāsi sayānopi bhāveyyāsi kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahantopi bhāveyyāsi puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantopi bhāveyyāsi.
an11.12:5.1: puna caparaṃ tvaṃ mahānāma dhammaṃ anussareyyāsi … saṃghaṃ
an11.12:5.6: santi devā cātummahārājikā santi devā … taduttari
an11.12:5.7: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati
an11.12:5.11: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha uppannā mayhampi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatīti
an11.12:5.12: yasmiṃ mahānāma samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañca devatānaṃ saddhañca sīlañca sutañca cāgañca paññañca anussarati nevassa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti
an11.12:5.13: ujugatamevassa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti devatā ārabbha
an11.12:5.14: ujugatacitto kho pana mahānāma ariyasāvako labhati atthavedaṃ labhati dhammavedaṃ labhati dhammūpasañhitaṃ pāmujjaṃ
an11.12:5.15: pamuditassa pīti jāyati pītimanassa kāyo passambhati passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an11.12:5.16: imaṃ kho tvaṃ mahānāma devatānussatiṃ gacchantopi bhāveyyāsi ṭhitopi bhāveyyāsi nisinnopi bhāveyyāsi sayānopi bhāveyyāsi kammantaṃ adhiṭṭhahantopi bhāveyyāsi puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantopi bhāveyyāsīti. 13
